collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager feels a knot of dread with no reason at all: have a friend sit with them, or go for a walk.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: All evening, (subject) has had a knot in (subject.his/her) stomach. Nothing is wrong. Dinner was good. The weather's fine. Everyone is well. But the feeling is there, tight and heavy, as if something bad is about to happen, and (subject.he/she) can't think what. (friend) notices (subject.him/her) staring into the fire.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) sits down. "Something wrong?" "I don't know," says (subject). "Nothing. Everything feels wrong and nothing is." (friend) doesn't try to fix it. (friend.He/she) just stays. They sit together until the fire is embers. The knot is still there when (subject) goes to bed. It's gone by morning. (subject.He/she) never finds out what it was.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) gets up and walks down to the beach. The waves come in, go out. The knot doesn't go. But walking helps a little, and the sound of the sea helps a little, and after a long while (subject.he/she) is tired enough to sleep. Some feelings don't come with reasons. (subject) is learning to let them come and go.
